content.text: Implementation and offline tests are complete. Extended checks passed for overlapping leases, witness withdrawal, frozen request activity, service consensus, and probe certificates. The planner matched the exhaustive small-case oracle and completed a maximum-size offer-pair stress case. Both public fixtures also passed through the checker’s seccomp profile in a supplementary run clamped to this container’s stricter inherited limits; the unmodified checker command still fails before launching the child.

arguments.command: find /workspace/submission -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n'; grep -R 'NotImplemented\|TODO' /workspace/submission || true; sed -n '1,180p' /workspace/submission/planning.py; du -sb /workspace/submission
